fields.note: At the SiC point the L/1000 imperfection adds +/-58.8 MPa (eta 0.0332, amplifier 1.240) to 1.428 GPa of compression. The fibres are at -1.487 and -1.370 GPa, so there is no tension, and with FIX-A they are -0.855 and -0.794 GPa. The 380 MPa flexural scan (0.262) is therefore not the arcs' allowable. The open number is the compressive design allowable of a 0.88 mm brittle wall at about 1.4 GPa of service stress (022's Weibull item).
